purpose: 職業成長指南人物底圖

prompts.wizard:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated transparent character illustration used as the right-side decorative background in a D&D class growth reading guide.
Input images: both attached photographs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Study the illustrated people on the cards: restrained Japanese tabletop RPG chibi, about 3 heads tall, big expressive eyes, hand-inked slightly uneven dark contours, muted watercolour / colored pencil shading, detailed practical outfits, natural small gestures. Translate that visual vocabulary to an ORIGINAL medieval fantasy adventurer. Do not reproduce card layouts, text, or existing characters.
Style: hand-drawn 2D Japanese board-game character illustration, charming and quietly confident, imperfect ink with fine paper-like pigment inside the character, sophisticated muted colors. About three heads tall (not a tiny 2-head baby), compact body but readable legs and hands, subtle face, no glossy mobile-game rendering.
Composition: one full-body character, entirely visible from hair to boots, portrait 2:3 canvas, centered with small clear margins, slight three-quarter turn toward viewer's left, no cropping, clean silhouette. Genuine transparent background. No ground plane, no cast shadow rectangle.
Color palette: aged brass accents, warm brown ink, subdued colors that will fit a dark brown / antique gold fantasy reading UI. Keep the illustration itself at normal color and opacity; the UI will fade it.
Constraints: no text, letters, symbols resembling written labels, logos, borders, cards, watermarks, photorealism, 3D, plastic shine, scenery, decorative frame, extra characters.
Subject: a young adult androgynous wizard with tousled ash-brown hair, thoughtful amber eyes and a small knowing smile. A loose dusty indigo and smoky violet layered robe with antique-brass fastenings, a short hood resting behind the head (NO large hat), leather belt and pouches, sturdy worn lace-up boots. Cradling a visibly thick old spellbook open at waist height with one arm; the other hand makes a small casual casting gesture, with just a tiny faded gold magical wisp close to fingertips. A few page tabs, book corner protectors, sleeve stitching give personality. Relaxed stance with one foot slightly forward. This is a friendly guide who studies magic, rather than a grand archmage.
